scope: engine-paired comparison on previously inspected development arrangements

geometry.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast for the aggregator; camera and depth heads outside autocast
geometry.rgb_preprocessing: Bicubic square stretch to 1024, then bilinear to 518 with align_corners=false
geometry.correspondence: 512-square reference-to-query floating projection; relative transform E_query @ inverse(E_ref)
geometry.occlusion: Positive finite depths, projected position inside the field, rounded destination depth sample, upstream adaptive depth threshold, 3-pixel ellipse dilation
geometry.native_grid: Interpolate coarse displacements at pixel centers. Require all positive-weight neighbors to be usable. Reject out-of-frame projections.
geometry.gate: Require a valid map and at least 60 percent usable pixels in the full half-open integer reference target box. Otherwise output UNKNOWN.
geometry.evidence: Same target match, quality, obstruction, detector, model weights, thresholds and resolution as baseline; linear warp for appearance and nearest for sharpness.
geometry.diagnostic_artifact: Float32 query x,y and validity mask in reference box with one-pixel halo; evaluator only

decision.on_pass: Replicate on fresh arrangements balanced by target identity.

include: every engine, environment, displacement and state
